Name: ligand_asym_id
Description: Ligand chain asymmetric id

Name: ligand_instance
Description: Biounit instance ID

Name: ligand_ccd_code
Description: Ligand Chemical Component Dictionary (CCD) code

Name: ligand_plip_type
Description: Ligand chain type classification

Name: ligand_bird_id
Description: Ligand BIRD id

Name: ligand_centroid
Description: Ligand center of geometry

Name: ligand_smiles
Description: Ligand SMILES from CCD/PRD lookup, or derived from resolved 3D if not in dictionary

Name: ligand_resolved_smiles
Description: SMILES from resolved 3D coordinates: bond orders from CCD template, stereochemistry from 3D geometry

Name: ligand_resolved_stereo_matches_template
Description: Whether resolved 3D stereo matches CCD template (True if achiral; None if no template)

Name: ligand_residue_numbers
Description: Resolved ligand residue numbers used to reconstruct this ligand chain from the source mmCIF

Name: ligand_water_residues
Description: Interacting water residues encoded as <instance>.<asym>_<residue_number>

Name: ligand_rdkit_canonical_smiles
Description: RDKit canonical SMILES (same as smiles; kept for schema compatibility)

Name: ligand_molecular_weight
Description: Molecular weight

Name: ligand_crippen_clogp
Description: Ligand Crippen MlogP, see https://www.rdkit.org/docs/source/rdkit.Chem.Crippen.html

Name: ligand_num_rot_bonds
Description: Number of rotatable bonds

Name: ligand_num_hbd
Description: Number of hydrogen bond donors

Name: ligand_num_hba
Description: Number of hydrogen bond acceptors

Name: ligand_num_rings
Description: Number of rings

Name: ligand_num_heavy_atoms
Description: Number of heavy atoms

Name: ligand_is_covalent
Description: Indicator of whether a ligand  is a covalent ligand

Name: ligand_covalent_linkages
Description: Ligand covalent linkages from _struct_conn (conn_type_id='covale'), format: {auth_seq}:{comp_id}:{chain}:{seq}:{atom}__{auth_seq}:{comp_id}:{chain}:{seq}:{atom}

Name: ligand_neighboring_residues
Description: Dictionary of neighboring residues, with {instance}.{chain} key and residue number value

Name: ligand_interacting_residues
Description: Dictionary of interacting residues, with {instance}.{chain} key and residue number value

Name: ligand_num_neighboring_ppi_atoms_within_4A_of_gap
Description: Number of missing neighboring protein-protein interface atoms within 4 Å of ligand of interest

Name: ligand_num_neighboring_ppi_atoms_within_8A_of_gap
Description: Number of missing neighboring protein-protein interface atoms within 8 Å of ligand of interest

Name: ligand_num_missing_ppi_interface_residues
Description: Number of missing neighboring protein-protein interface residues within 4 Å of ligand of interest

Name: ligand_num_pli_atoms_within_4A_of_gap
Description: Number of missing neighboring protein-ligand interface atoms within 4 Å of ligand of interest

Name: ligand_num_pli_atoms_within_8A_of_gap
Description: Number of missing neighboring protein-ligand interface atoms within 8 Å of ligand of interest

Name: ligand_num_missing_pli_interface_residues
Description: Number of missing neighboring protein-ligand interface residues within 4 Å of ligand of interest

Name: ligand_num_resolved_heavy_atoms
Description: Number of resolved heavy atoms in a ligand

Name: ligand_num_unresolved_heavy_atoms
Description: Number of unresolved heavy atoms in a ligand

Name: ligand_tpsa
Description: Topological polar surface area

Name: ligand_qed
Description: Ligand QED score, a measure of drug-likeness, see https://www.rdkit.org/new_docs/source/rdkit.Chem.QED.html

Name: ligand_is_ion
Description: Indicator of whether a ligand  is an ion

Name: ligand_is_lipinski
Description: Indicator of whether a ligand satisfies Lipinski Ro5

Name: ligand_is_fragment
Description: Indicator of whether a ligand satisfies fragment Ro3

Name: ligand_is_oligo
Description: Indicator of whether a ligand  is an oligopeptide, oligosaccharide or oligopeptide

Name: ligand_is_cofactor
Description: Indicator of whether a ligand is a cofactor

Name: ligand_in_artifact_list
Description: Indicator of whether a ligand is in the artifact list

Name: ligand_is_artifact
Description: Indicator of whether a ligand is an artifact

Name: ligand_is_other
Description: Indicator of whether a ligand type is not classified as any types of small molecule (Lipinski, Fragment or covalent), ion, cofactor, oligo (peptide, saccharide or nucleotide) or artifact

Name: ligand_is_invalid
Description: Indicator of whether a ligand is invalid

Name: ligand_unique_ccd_code
Description: Ligand representative CCD code after de-duplicating

Name: ligand_protein_chains_asym_id
Description: Receptor chain IDs (protein/NA) within neighboring threshold of ligand.          Returns empty list if the ligand is an artifact.

Name: ligand_num_interacting_residues
Description: Number of residues interacting with a given ligand.

Name: ligand_num_neighboring_residues
Description: Total count of receptor residues (protein/NA) within neighboring threshold.

Name: ligand_is_proper
Description: Check if ligand is a proper ligand (not an ion or artifact)

Name: ligand_num_interactions
Description: Number of interactions for a given ligand.

Name: ligand_num_unique_interactions
Description: Number of unique interactions

Name: ligand_num_crystal_contacted_residues
Description: Number of residues from other symmetry mates which are in contact with this ligand.

Name: ligand_num_atoms_with_crystal_contacts
Description: Number of atoms in this ligand which are in contact with residues from other symmetry mates.

Name: ligand_fraction_atoms_with_crystal_contacts
Description: Fraction of atoms in this ligand which are in contact with residues from other symmetry mates.

Name: ligand_num_pocket_residues
Description: Number of residues in the ligand's binding pocket.

Name: ligand_id
Description: Unique identifier for a given ligand.

Name: ligand_instance_chain
Description: Instance chain for a given ligand.

Name: ligand_binding_affinity
Description: Binding affinity (pKd or pKi) from BindingDB when available.          The affinity is only returned if the BindingDB target sequence         matches at least one receptor chain SEQRES with 100% identity         in the aligned core (terminal overhangs from tags/truncations         are tolerated).  This guards against BindingDB's 85% sequence         identity matching which can assign values to wrong complexes         (see `#94 <https://github.com/plinder-org/plinder/issues/94>`_).
